instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!
Preheat oven to 350°F. Line two large baking sheet pans with parchment paper.
Place cake mix, eggs, oil, and food coloring in a medium bowl, then stir until combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (14 oz) box white cake mix
½ cup neutral vegetable oil
4 drop green food coloring

instructions.primary_message: Use a small cookie scoop (or rounded tablespoon measure) to portion cookies and arrange on the baking sheets, spacing them about 1 inch apart. Place baking sheets in the preheated oven and bake until golden around the edges, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
When the cookies have cooled slightly, gently press candy eyes into each cookie. Use icing to add a "mouth" to each "monster."
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mini candy eyeballs
1 (1.3 oz) tube black writing icing or gel

instructions.primary_message: Arrange cookies on a platter, share, and enjoy!
